extraction_notes: The BZT52B5V6S row was transcribed from the shared electrical-characteristics table: VZ min 5.49 V, nominal 5.6 V, max 5.71 V at IZT = 5 mA; ZZT = 40 ohm; ZZK = 400 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; IR max = 1 uA at VR = 2 V.
The zener curve points are digitized readings from the labeled BZT52B5V6S trace in the p. 3 family plot; no interpolation was added.
The datasheet provides characteristic plots for capacitance and impedance but no single numeric capacitance or reverse-recovery-time table value for this part.
Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW, VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and Tj = -55 to +150 degC.
